name: captains-cabinet
description: An autonomous, self-improving AI organization framework for Claude Code — Captain (founder) + a roster-derived officer fleet (live portfolio deployment: cos Chair + polads-ceo + stephie-ceo + comms-officer) with event-sourced missions, durable role registry, OVI measurement, and pattern-learning ledger. Three-layer architecture (framework + preset + instance) for product-agnostic deployment; presets ship role archetypes (work: functional officers, portfolio: Chair + generated lane CEOs), the instance roster decides what actually runs.
